definitions.ask: Which cursor rows should hop through a Task Link to a Gmail Task?
definitions.why: Matches the glossary Task Link shape and keeps eligibility auditable on one line

choices.label: Only a plain bullet whose sole content is one wikilink (the Pomodoro Task Link shape)
First block-ref link anywhere on the cursor's line; wider but surprising on multi-link rows

definitions.ask: Keep the bob-mail `<M-CR>` / `<M-Enter>` vim normal-mode mapping as a fallback?
definitions.why: Harmless where shadowed, useful where the hotkey binding is missing

choices.label: Mapping stays; fires where Meta+Enter is unbound, stays inert where the hotkey shadows it
Dispatcher is the only path; less code, but the gesture dies where the nav hotkey is absent

definitions.ask: Should bob plugins sync warn when it deploys a plugin that community-plugins.json does not enable?
definitions.why: Sync deployed bob-mail for a day while Obsidian never loaded it, and nothing said so

choices.label: Sync warns (table and JSON) when a deployed plugin id is missing from community-plugins.json
Sync output unchanged; enablement stays visible only in bob plugins list

definitions.ask: Update the glossary gmail-task strand's Cmd+Enter sentence for dispatcher delivery and Task Link coverage?
definitions.corrects: with the cursor anywhere on the row, `<cmd+enter>` (vim normal mode) opens the thread in the browser from the mail note's `gmail_url`, and a muted `⌘↵ Gmail` chip on the cursor row shows exactly when that keymap is live
